name: Nanchang Good Morning 2021

venue.name: Zhongchang Red Net Center, 199 Yulin Road, Jingkai District
venue.address: Zhongchang Red Net Center, 199 Yulin Road, Jingkai District

information: The structure of the competition in Nanchang this year has been modified due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Competitors are only allowed to compete in one of the two competitions, [Nanchang Good Morning 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NanchangGoodMorning2021) and [Nanchang Good Afternoon 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NanchangGoodAfternoon2021), in two half-days respectively.
